title: Kanzen Kaihi Healer no Kiseki
titleNative: 完全回避ヒーラーの軌跡
synonyms: The Path of the Perfect Evasion Healer
synopsis: A college student, Sakurai Hiroki was summoned to another world to defeat the Demon Lord. And since he got “Priest” as a job, his starting Recovery Stat was more than enough to heal any wounds, so he dumped all of his Stat Points into Evasion. In other words, he’s aiming for an Evasion Healer who will never get hit by enemy attacks. But unfortunately, people in that world couldn’t understand his ideal! The King got angry at him and almost immediately labeled him as useless! And thus, the story of how Hiroki become an odd Healer who can even avoid Dungeon Boss’ attacks with ease has started!!

title: Goodbye, Dragon Life
titleNative: さようなら竜生, こんにちは人生
synonyms: Goodbye Dragon Life Hello Human Life
synopsis: After living a long life as the strongest and oldest dragon, he is slain by a human hero. He awakes to find himself reborn as a human, Dolan, in a remote village. He works hard as a farmer and sometimes hunts for food. His life is simple in this small village, but he is surrounded by love. He soon finds happiness he'd never experienced in his life as a dragon. However, dangerous monsters are lurking around his village lately and he goes to the woods to investigate when he finds out an army of monsters are heading his way... (Source: Alpha Manga)

title: Real demo Shiawase ni Shite Kudasai ne?
titleRomaji: Real demo Shiawase ni Shite Kudasai ne?
titleNative: 現実世界でも幸せにしてくださいね？
synonyms: Be Happy in the Real World Too, Okay?
synopsis: High school girl Machino, who longs for the "love of destiny," loves to play the dating-sim game "Celestia." Despite maximizing the affection with all of the girls in the game, she can't decide on which one to choose for the confession event. After agonizing over the decision for days, an explosion occurs just as a shooting star flies over her house, and when Machino opens her eyes, she finds herself face to face with Sofia, the main heroine of Celestia.... "Machino... I always wanted to say it... I love you." An isekai summoning yuri harem romantic comedy begins, as her highly affectionate heroines jump into the real world! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
